name: Kiriya Ai
source:
[i]The silent third daughter[/i]

An emotionless girl who barely interacts with other people.

She is cold-hearted and rarely shows her emotions.

She seems to view people as if they are not even human. The only person she can have a proper conversation with is her older sister, Botan, who is one year older than her.

As Sumi commands, Daisuke holds her like a doll.

[Translated from [url=https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HB/kiriya/main.html]Official Site[/url]]
